title: 2025 BMW X3
description: Sophisticated, spacious and rewarding to drive, this 2025 BMW X3 20 brings premium SUV appeal in Black Sapphire Metal. This used BMW X3 20 combines the versatility of a five-door SUV with the polished performance buyers expect from the badge. Its 2.0-litre petrol engine works with an automatic Steptronic transmission to deliver smooth, confident progress, while rear-wheel drive adds a balanced, engaging feel on the road. With only 11 095 km covered, it presents as a modern, low-mileage option for drivers wanting everyday practicality with a premium edge. Inside, the X3 offers seating for five and a flexible load area of 570 litres, expanding to 1 700 litres when more space is needed. It also brings strong peace of mind and convenience, backed by a 5-year/100 000 km maintenance plan, 2-year unlimited-kilometre warranty, and a generous list of standard features that enhance comfort, connectivity and driver assistance. Key Features: • Black Sapphire Metal exterior • Automatic Steptronic transmission • Active/adaptive cruise control • LED headlights • Navigation • Head-up display • Surround / top / area view cameras
